decisions.reason: As a close-to-core line with several variants and its own webpage in a growing market, it likely meets or comes close to aspiration levels, so even a small firm would usually retain it.

A hyaluronic serum fits the firm's established natural facial-care business and the absence of any negative signal suggests no clear performance shortfall large enough to trigger dropping it despite limited slack.

Although only briefly mentioned and therefore probably less central than Product A, this cleansing milk is still close to the core range and in a favorable industry context, making retention more likely than withdrawal.
